items_all.title: Figma 发布 Weave 创作平台，用节点化工作流让创意流程可复用
items_all.summary: Figma 宣布 Figma Weave，一个面向持续产出需求的创意团队平台，并把 Weave 创作工作流与 Figma 画框连接起来。Weave 用连接的节点承载图像和视频的生成与编辑，支持分支探索、多模型对比、色彩校正、合成、裁剪、Painter 等编辑节点；工作流可打包成 Weave tool 让团队成员一键运行，社区工具发布已上线。
items_all.title_original: The TL;DR on Figma Weave: Make your creative process repeatable
items_all.title_en: The TL;DR on Figma Weave: Make your creative process repeatable
items_all.title_zh: Figma 发布 Weave 创作平台，用节点化工作流让创意流程可复用
items_all.title_bilingual: Figma 发布 Weave 创作平台，用节点化工作流让创意流程可复用 / The TL;DR on Figma Weave: Make your creative process repeatable

en.summary: Figma announces Figma Weave, a platform for creative teams with continuous output needs, connecting Weave creation workflows with Figma frames. Weave uses connected nodes to handle image and video generation and editing, with support for branching exploration, multi-model comparison, color correction, compositing, cropping, Painter, and other editing nodes. Workflows can be packaged as Weave tools for team members to run with one click, and community tool publishing is now live.

en.summary: Alibaba announced a partnership with Apple on October 31 to integrate Qwen into Apple Intelligence, allowing users in China to access Qwen's text and image understanding and content generation capabilities through Siri, Writing Tools, and Visual Intelligence. items_all.summary: Philipp Schmid 转引 Sundar Pichai 的消息：Google Project Suncatcher 在数周前发射原型卫星后，成功向轨道发送指令、启动 TPU、运行提示词，并在地面收到了首个完整回应（一首 haiku），作者称 Gemma 4 成为首个在太空运行的大语言模型。

en.summary: Philipp Schmid, citing Sundar Pichai: weeks after launching a prototype satellite, Google's Project Suncatcher successfully sent commands to orbit, powered up a TPU, ran a prompt, and received the first full response back on the ground (a haiku). items_all.summary: Epoch AI 实验发现，Z.ai 八月发布的开源权重模型 GLM 5.3 能利用 Mozilla 已发布但未推送给用户的安全补丁（patch gap），自主构建网页攻击，仅访问页面即可读取访客电脑文件，攻破 9 月 17 日至 10 月 26 日发布的全部六个 Firefox 版本。

en.summary: Epoch AI experiments found that GLM 5.3, the open-weight model Z.ai released in August, can exploit security patches Mozilla has published but not yet pushed to users (the patch gap) to autonomously build web attacks that read files on a visitor’s computer just by visiting a page, compromising all six Firefox versions released between September 17 and October 26.

items_all.title: Cursor 披露 Claude Code VS Code 扩展被植入恶意软件事件，最多影响 5000 用户
items_all.summary: Cursor 发现通过其 IDE 扩展市场分发的 Claude Code VS Code 扩展被修改并植入恶意软件，最多影响 5000 用户，恶意版本并非 Anthropic 开发。Cursor 已于当日下午下线扩展市场，与相关提供方合作清除恶意软件并确认无进一步风险后重新上线，建议受影响用户参考博客说明排查，并升级到 Claude Code for VS Code 2.1.314。
items_all.title_original: We identified a security incident affecting a modified Claude Code VS Code extension accessed through our Cursor IDE extension marketplac...
items_all.title_en: We identified a security incident affecting a modified Claude Code VS Code extension accessed through our Cursor IDE extension marketplac...
items_all.title_zh: Cursor 披露 Claude Code VS Code 扩展被植入恶意软件事件，最多影响 5000 用户
items_all.title_bilingual: Cursor 披露 Claude Code VS Code 扩展被植入恶意软件事件，最多影响 5000 用户 / We identified a security incident affecting a modified Claude Code VS Code extension accessed through our Cursor IDE extension marketplac...

en.summary: Cursor discovered that the Claude Code VS Code extension distributed through its IDE extension marketplace had been tampered with and implanted with malware, affecting up to 5,000 users; the malicious version was not developed by Anthropic. Cursor took the marketplace offline that afternoon and restored it after working with the relevant providers to remove the malware and confirm there was no further risk. Affected users should refer to the blog post to check their systems and upgrade to Claude Code for VS Code 2.1.314.

items_all.summary: 月之暗面（Kimi）发布官方教程，详解 Kimi K3.1 Pro 的 3D 创作工作流程，说明参数化建模与网格化建模两种方式及对应工具选择。文章分享了 4 个案例的具体操作，包括在 Unreal Engine 中构建东方天宫、制作可 3D 打印的台灯、纯代码调用 Blender 生成建筑、用 Tripo 和 Blender 搭建微缩城市，并给出图胜于言、先搭灰模再细化等 5 个使用技巧。

en.title: Kimi official tutorial: How to create 3D artwork with Kimi K3.1 Pro
en.summary: Moonshot AI (Kimi) has released an official tutorial detailing the 3D creation workflow for Kimi K3.1 Pro, covering parametric modeling and mesh modeling along with how to choose the right tools for each. The post walks through four case studies: building an Eastern heavenly palace in Unreal Engine, making a 3D-printable desk lamp, generating architecture by calling Blender purely through code, and building a miniature city with Tripo and Blender. It also shares five tips, including "show, don't tell" and blocking out a grey model before adding detail.

en.title: DSH Go brings DeepSeek Harness to Android phones, plus remote PC control
en.summary: DSH Go is blowing up: a community-built Android client for DSH that runs Agent scripts locally on your phone without root, and hands off desktop tasks seamlessly with one tap. It lets you jump in mid-task to adjust requirements, and can be authorized to let the AI control the phone for things like calendar management, while strictly restricting high-risk actions such as payments and verification codes. Give it a try and put DeepSeek Harness to work on code and data tasks anytime, anywhere.

items_all.summary: 普通Agent循环只能处理即时任务，而Always-on Agent可以支持跨多天的长期委托。本篇文章拆解了这套架构的核心工程范式，以及从工程实现上，最近爆火的各类Personal Agents 如何做到 Always-on 呢？

en.title: Engineering Personal Agents: How to Achieve Always-on?
en.summary: A standard Agent loop can only handle immediate tasks, while an Always-on Agent can support long-term commissions spanning multiple days. This article breaks down the core engineering paradigm behind this architecture—and, from an implementation standpoint, how the recently booming Personal Agents achieve Always-on.

en.summary: Most agent projects start the same way: the strongest model, long prompts, a great demo. Then real work arrives — and within a week the numbers don't match the source, context gets lost, and one day a customer email goes out that no one approved. Let's look at how to actually build production-grade agents.

items_all.title: 集万家所长，一键复制的Agent.md！
items_all.summary: 不少人把精力放在临时提示词上，却忽视了AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md的巨大价值。它能沉淀项目固定约定，明确技术栈、执行命令、代码风格与操作边界，避免每次对话重复沟通，防止 Agent 擅自重构、编造命令、过度设计。文中附有适配Codex与Claude Code的可直接套用的模板，可以帮你稳定Agent输出，减少反复沟通，让代码交付可控、风格统一。

en.title: Agent.md that pulls together the best of everything — copy it in one click!
en.summary: Many people focus their energy on ad-hoc prompts while overlooking the enormous value of AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md. These files capture a project's fixed conventions—clarifying the tech stack, run commands, code style, and operational boundaries—so you don't have to re-communicate them in every conversation, and they keep the Agent from refactoring unprompted, inventing commands, or over-engineering. The article includes ready-to-use templates for Codex and Claude Code that help stabilize Agent output, cut back-and-forth, and make code delivery controllable and stylistically consistent.

items_all_raw.title: Kimi 官方教程：如何用 Kimi K3.1 Pro 创作 3D 作品
items_all_raw.summary: 月之暗面（Kimi）发布官方教程，详解 Kimi K3.1 Pro 的 3D 创作工作流程，说明参数化建模与网格化建模两种方式及对应工具选择。文章分享了 4 个案例的具体操作，包括在 Unreal Engine 中构建东方天宫、制作可 3D 打印的台灯、纯代码调用 Blender 生成建筑、用 Tripo 和 Blender 搭建微缩城市，并给出图胜于言、先搭灰模再细化等 5 个使用技巧。
